CustomField.description: 35312 : Booking Verification: Expand Booking Verification to UKI & hide Submit For Booking until Passed
CustomField.formula:
IF( OR( /* Condition 1: For UK and Ireland */
AND( OR(QTB_Billing_Country_Name__c='United Kingdom', QTB_Billing_Country_Name__c='Ireland'), OR(RecordType.Name='Standard Opportunity', RecordType.Name='IMLA Standard Opportunity', RecordType.Name='IME Standard Opportunity', RecordType.Name='IMAP Standard Opportunity'), OR(Amount / CURRENCYRATE(TEXT(CurrencyIsoCode)) < 5000, ISPICKVAL(Deal_Validation__c,'Pass')), ISPICKVAL(StageName,'5 - Signed/PO in') ),
/* Condition 2: Other Countries As it is */
QTB_Billing_Country_Name__c='France', QTB_Billing_Country_Name__c='Belgium', QTB_Billing_Country_Name__c='Netherlands', QTB_Billing_Country_Name__c='Sweden', QTB_Billing_Country_Name__c='Denmark' ),
IF(ISPICKVAL(Type,'Renewal'), HYPERLINK("/apex/renewalOppWizard2_step1_Lightning?oppId="+ Id, "Submit for Booking"),
IF(Owner_isActive__c!=TRUE, '', IF(ISPICKVAL(StageName,'5 - Signed/PO in'), HYPERLINK("/apex/NCSPWizard_Step2_Lightning?oppId="+ Id, "Submit for Booking"), '' ) ) ), '' )
CustomField.label: Submit for Booking(Send to NCSP)
